svg.title: The hardware-in-the-loop search: every reward is a real simulation
svg.desc: A search engine on the left proposes a mapping for the three attention stages; it crosses into a simulator on the right which returns measured utilisation; the number returns as a reward. The figure steps through the ten mappings of one real search run.

text.tspan: Bayesian optimisation — all behind one interface
SCALE-Sim 3.0.0 in a pinned Docker image
one cycle-accurate run per attention stage

g.text: reward r = U − λ · T / M
U: measured PE utilisation · T: SRAM↔DRAM traffic · M: multiply-accumulates · λ = 0.01
No surrogate model and no interpolation: a failed run is logged as failed, never dropped or replaced.

svg.text: Source: experiments/exp3_main_sweep/results/raw/exp3_perstage.csv · A2C, seed 2, seq 256 on a 32×32 array (real log)
